# Wilkes University

> > Wilkes University is a private institution in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, offering undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on academic excellence, global engagement, and community outreach.

The university maintains MSCHE accreditation and NC-SARA compliance, serving students through various academic programs, STEM initiatives like Science in Motion, and support services. Campus operations are managed through Business Operations, Human Resources, and Finance offices, with leadership under President Greg Cant.

## University Leadership and Mission

- [Mission, Vision and Values](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/mission-vision-values.aspx): Institutional identity defining Wilkes University's mission and values
- [The President's Office](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/leadership/presidents-office/index.aspx): President Greg Cant's office and strategic leadership initiatives
- [Middle States Accreditation](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/accreditation-and-rankings/middle-states/index.aspx): MSCHE institutional accreditation and self-study process information

## Student Services and Support

- [Financial Clearance Options](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/finance-office/financial-clearance-options.aspx): Student payment options including FAFSA and TouchNet payment plans
- [Student Complaint Process](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/accreditation-and-rankings/student-complaint-process.aspx): NC-SARA complaint procedures for internal and external grievances

## Academic Programs and Outreach

- [Science in Motion - SIM in Action](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/centers-and-institutes/science-in-motion/science-in-action.aspx): Science in Motion STEM outreach programs for K-12 schools
- [Conservatory Classes](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/arts/conservatory/conservatory-classes.aspx): Music and dance classes including Bharata Natyam instruction
- [Global Engagement Staff](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/centers-and-institutes/center-for-global-education-and-diversity/staff.aspx): Office of Global Engagement staff for study abroad and international students
- [SHINE Community Resources](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/centers-and-institutes/shine/resources.aspx): SHINE program community resources including CareerLink and job training

## Administrative Offices and Staff

- [Human Resources Staff](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/human-resources/staff.aspx): HR staff directory with contact information and payroll services
- [Business Operations Staff](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/business-operations/staff.aspx): Directory of Business Operations staff including procurement services
- [Supervisor and Employment Forms](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/human-resources/supervisor-and-employment-forms.aspx): HR forms for hiring, performance evaluation, and staff searches
- [Separating Employees](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/human-resources/separatingEE.aspx): Employee exit process and clearance forms for separating staff
- [Vendor Registration](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/offices-and-administration/business-operations/vendor-registration.aspx): Supplier registration process and bid list for university vendors

## Optional

- [Gala Awards](https://www.wilkes.edu/about-wilkes/leadership/presidents-office/gala-awards.aspx): Founders Gala awards including President's Medal and Chairperson's Award
